channel.title: Bloomberg — diagnostic source feed
channel.description: Diagnostic feed grouped by acquisition connector.

item.title: Musk’s SpaceX Acquiring Crucial Swath of Spectrum
item.description: SpaceX is acquiring a crucial swath of spectrum from Grain Management. The new spectrum allows SpaceX to beam cell service to devices indoors from its Starlink network of satellites and will be combined with a terrestrial network to connect devices everywhere. Sana Pashankar reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI Targets $70 Billion in Annualized Revenue by Year-End
item.description: OpenAI is expecting to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualized revenue by the end of the year, driven largely by growth in its enterprise business. Ed Ludlow reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Andreessen Horowitz Backs Jev Maker at $7.5 Billion Value
item.description: TypeSafe AI, the startup behind Jev, a new artificial intelligence model that went viral after it launched only a few weeks ago, has raised about $870 million at a $7.5 billion valuation in a financing led by Andreessen Horowitz.
item.dc:creator: Natasha Mascarenhas and Rebecca Torrence

item.title: Burnham Says UK Will Curb Non-Compete Clauses After Tech, AI Startup Outcry
item.description: The UK is set to curb hiring restrictions that force employees to wait before moving jobs or starting companies, an issue that has drawn the ire of the nation’s technology startups.
item.dc:creator: Shona Ghosh

item.title: Facebook Whistleblowers Don’t All Get the Hollywood Treatment
item.description: The ‘Social Reckoning’ depicts one insider’s story while another lands in court
item.dc:creator: Georgia Fearn

item.title: We Want to 'Dominate' US: Revolut's Storonsky
item.description: Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky lays out the fintech’s ambitions to crack the US market and take on established players including JPMorgan and American Express. He says Revolut plans to build out a full digital banking offer, from credit cards to loans, while using AI and automation to reshape how customers bank. The company is also preparing to test AI agents that can shop and transact on behalf of users. He speaks to Tom Mackenzie at the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin for the latest episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Medtech Faces One More Weak Quarter Before a 2027 Rebound
item.description: Medical technology companies face one more subdued earnings quarter before heading into 2027 with their strongest growth outlook in more than two years, following a punishing stretch of policy uncertainty, cyberattacks and device recalls.
item.dc:creator: Chloé Meley

item.title: Bending Spoons CEO Sees Opportunity in ‘SaaSpocalypse’
item.description: Bending Spoons CEO Luca Ferrari says falling software valuations are creating acquisition opportunities as AI reshapes the industry. He says the company is benefiting twice - from cheaper targets and from using AI to write code, improve products and scale its acquisition model faster. Bending Spoons says AI now writes at least 90% of its code. He speaks to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Tech: Europe" (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: China Is Trouncing the US in Consumer Adoption of Generative AI
item.description: The US scores high on AI capability, but lags China in adoption.
item.dc:creator: Saritha Rai

item.title: Revolut CEO Aims To Rival JPMorgan, American Express
item.description: Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky says he wants his fast-growing fintech to 'dominate' the US market and take on established players. He speaks to Tom Mackenzie at the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin for the latest episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Virgin Media Bonds Slide Deeper Into Distress on Snagged Deal
item.description: Virgin Media O2’s bonds are slumping again on Friday, extending weeks of declines that have sent its notes to deeply distressed levels.
item.dc:creator: Libby Cherry

item.title: Koch Nets Nearly $1 Billion From Infor Payouts in Two Years
item.description: A unit of Koch Inc. received a payout of almost $700 million from software firm Infor’s international business last year, according to a UK filing, taking the total dividend for the past two financial years to almost $1 billion.
item.dc:creator: Neil Callanan and Kiel Porter

item.title: AI in Banking: Risk and Reward | Bloomberg Tech: Europe 10/9/2026
item.description:
This episode of Bloomberg Tech: Europe, from the Wave by Vento tech conference in Turin, examines how artificial intelligence is moving deeper into banking. Tom Mackenzie explores how banks are using AI to become faster and more efficient, and the new vulnerabilities that could emerge as the technology takes on more consequential decisions. Guests include JPMorgan CEO Jamie Dimon, Revolut CEO Nik Storonsky, Evident CEO Alexandra Mousavizadeh and Bending Spoons CEO Luca Ferrari.
"Bloomberg Tech: Europe" spotlights the biggest names and trends shaping the region's technology ecosystem as the global competition heats up. This monthly, 30-minute magazine-style show features in-depth interviews with top technology leaders, as well as major investors and policymakers - giving you a compelling A to Z of the most consequential innovations, opportunities and challenges. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Goldman Says Investors to Shift Focus to AI Monetization
item.description: Christian Mueller-Glissmann, head of asset allocation research at Goldman Sachs, discusses market skepticism toward artificial intelligence. Speaking on Bloomberg Television, he says investors are questioning whether ongoing capital expenditure will translate into monetizable products. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Jefferies’ Chris Wood Sees ‘Massive Capital Destruction’ in AI
item.description: The most likely long-term outcome of the AI boom will be massive capital destruction in the US, with market share going to cheaper open-source Chinese models, according to Jefferies Financial Group Inc.
item.dc:creator: Faseeh Mangi

item.title: Bending Spoons CEO Sees Buying Opportunities in SaaSpocalypse
item.description: Falling valuations for software companies create buying opportunities, Bending Spoons SpA Chief Executive Officer Luca Ferrari said, as his firm aims to benefit from artificial intelligence disrupting the industry.
item.dc:creator: Daniele Lepido and Tom Mackenzie

item.title: 'Last Night I Had Nightmares' Says Airtel Money CEO Before IPO
item.description: Mobile payments firm Airtel Money starts trading on the London Stock Exchange on Friday, a listing that may mark the largest initial public offering for the bourse in five years. How the company trades will be the next test in London’s efforts to revitalize its capital markets. A strong first day would imply the city is fertile ground for IPOs and may encourage more companies to list on the LSE. At the same time, a debut that slips below the offer price would send a negative signal through the market, potentially deterring listing candidates. Airtel Money's CEO Ian Ferrao joined Caroline Heper and Charles Capel on Bloomberg Radio to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Why JPMorgan Is the Most AI-Advanced Bank
item.description: Artificial Intelligence deployment across banking is moving at its fastest pace yet, with JPMorgan yet again leading Evident Insight’s ranking of the world’s most AI-advanced banks. Evident CEO and co-founder Alexandra Mousavizadeh explains why early movers are pulling ahead and why banks investing most heavily in the technology are still growing headcount even as AI changes jobs. She speaks to Tom Mackenzie on the latest episode of "Bloomberg Tech: Europe." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: OpenAI Expects $70 Billion in Annualized Revenue by End of 2026
item.description: OpenAI is expecting to reach or exceed $70 billion in annualized revenue by the end of the year, according to people familiar with the matter, driven largely by growth in its enterprise business.
item.dc:creator: Rebecca Torrence and Shirin Ghaffary

item.title: Nvidia-Backed Lumentum Sold Out of AI Server Parts Till 2029
item.description: Lumentum Holdings Inc.’s optical components are “completely sold out” through early 2029 on demand from tech companies clamoring for faster AI data centers, according to its chief executive officer.
item.dc:creator: Takashi Mochizuki, Shery Ahn and Mari Kiyohara
